tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs nyin byed snang ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru mañju shrī gho ṣa ya/ 'dir 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na bsgom par 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser las 'od zer 'phros/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs/ tha mal pa'i lus kyang stong pa nyid du gyur/ 'od zer dhīḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na sku mdog dmar ser nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon pas ut+pal gyi yu ba thugs kar bzung bas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes phyin gyi po ti bsnams pa lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog dang zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur/ lce'i rtsa bar dhīḥdamar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan pa las 'od 'phros pas ngag gi nyes skyon sbyangs/ bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig gi mthar/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus phyi nang thams cad khyab pas sdig sgrib dang brjed ngas dang mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi shes rab spobs pa gzungs la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes pa brgya stong sogs bzlas mthar/ lce'i rtsa ba'i dhīḥl sems gtad de/

dhīḥbargya rtsa bgrang*/ dbugs nang du 'ong ba'i tshe'ang dhīḥbagrangs pas/ dhīḥyig gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang shes rab dpag tu med pa skyes par bsam mo// mjug tu ār+ya mañju shrī ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ pūṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron ma rab gsal bas// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes pas bstod/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ zhes brjod la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags pa 'jam dpal 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ dus thams cad du lce'i rtsa ba'i dhīḥlas dhīḥyig dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsams la/ dhīḥci nus su bgrang ngo*// zhes 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs nyin byed snang ba 'di'ang bzo rig pa a srung gi mi brjed dran gsal ched du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru tā rā yai/ sgrol ma sgrub la sbyor dngos rjes// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// rje btsun sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas bgyi// lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos rnams stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pad dkar zla ba'i gdan stengs su// rang dang bsrung bya dbyer med sems// tāṃ yig las byung sgrol ma dkar// mchog sbyin ut+pal bsnams ma'i sku// dar bab rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// spyan bdun zla bar rgyab brten ma// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i dbus// zla ba 'khor lo'i lte bar tāṃ// rang 'dra spyan drangs dbyer med thim// rigs lnga byon nas chu dbang bskur// dbang thob 'od dpag med pas brgyan// bzlas pa ni/

tāṃ gyi mdun rgyab oṃ hā'i bar// ma ma ā yur puṇ+ya dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru dang*// rtsibs brgyad tā re tut+tā re// tu re swā yis mtshan pa gsal// sngags las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das tshe// bsod nams ye shes bdag la bsdus// oṃ tā re tuta tā re tu re swā hā/ snying po dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ti lab+dheḥ.ā yuḥpuṇ+ya dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ tshe sbyin sgrol mas bdag gzhan la// 'chi med tshe ring dngos grub stsol// dngos gzhi'o// dge bas sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro kun de yi sar 'god shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rjes so// sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dung 'don ched// tshul rin bod pas 'phral du bris// ༈ //na mo gu ra we/ bsnyen mtshams skabs sogs cha gsum cho ga rgyas pa mi shes pas bsdus pa btang bar 'dod na gtor ma gsum bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ sngags de nyid kyi ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pa'i tshab tu na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā bh+yo bi shwa zhes sogs btags pa gsum gyis bsngos la/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs spyi ltar brjod/ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ 'byung po'i gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs dran pa tsam byas la/ oṃ ma hā bhū ta lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mgron bkug sngags de nyid la na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa gsum gyis bsngos la/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// chos don ldan pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag sogs byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i stong grogs mdzod// zhes dang*/

ma hā bhū ta lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ bgegs gtor ni/ oṃ sarba bigh+na na ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ slar yang ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ'i tshab tu na ma sarba ta thā ga tā sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ zhes dang*/ drag sngags gang rung brjod pas bskrad do// zhes cha gsum gyi gtor ma bsdus pa bya tshul 'di'ang don gnyer gyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// g.yang sgrub sogs kyi skabs bse rag bcings thabs bzhugs so// ༄༅// bse rag kha chings 'di ltar bcings// dang po rmi lam 'di ltar 'ong*// rang gi thob pa'i zas nor dag /gzhan ma dag gis khyer ba dang*// snod stong mtha' ma bskor ba dang*// sprang po ngan slong yid mi 'ong*// kun gyi gseb na 'dug pa rmi// de ltar byung na kha chings bya// dang po gtor ma chu gtor sbyin// bden pa rgya cher brdar bar bya// de nas sa sbyin dag la ni// mchod rten dkar po khru gang bya// bum par rten 'brel snying po dang*// phyag rdor rgyal chen bzhi yi sngags// legs par bris la bum par bcug /mchod rten gdan khri'i 'og tu ni// bse rag 'gong po'i lto bar ni// tsakra rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bcas// rtsibs la sngags 'di dgod par bya// ra dza tri 'u ha sha tri rbad/ chings nan/ mchan la/ 'gong po yaṃ sho nan/ 'gong po tri'u nan/ ra dza kha thaṃ/ ra dza tri kha thaṃ/ god sri kha thaṃ/ sris rkun kha thaṃ/ pag shu mu tra kha thaṃ/ lte bar/ tri'u yaṃ sho tri sho/ gang gnod ming bri/

bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten bca' zhing sgrub par byed pa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas mi nor longs spyod 'phel ba la bgegs dang bar chad byed pa'i mi rgyud gcod pa'i 'dre/ dbul 'dre/ phongs 'dre/ ltogs 'dre/ mug 'dre/ god 'dre/ sris rkun la sogs pa bse rag 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad kha chings kha thaṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ mu khyud la/ ya tri kha thaṃ/ ma tri kha thaṃ/ a tri kha thaṃ/ su tri kha thaṃ/ ra tri kha thaṃ/ kan+ni kha thaṃ/ du tri kha thaṃ/ tsa tri kha thaṃ/ sngon dmar skud pas rgya gram bcings// la chas gtums la gdan khrir bzhugs// drag po'i sngags 'dis skabs su gzir// oṃ ni lam bha ra bha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ya k+ṣa ra dza ku be ra be ru ra ga sid+dhi ma me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bai sha ma ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ pa tra ta ra tsi ya swā hā/ oṃ be du tri ya swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ ra dza yak+ṣa tri'u nan/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di skabs su bzlas/ mchod rten mal gyi rtsibs logs sba// skabs su mchod dang bskor ba byas// dus su sngags kyang drag tu bzlas// mi yi ma mthong par bya'o// 'di ni kha chings dang po'o// gnyis pa byang bu sor bzhi la// sngags 'di tshar gsum bris nas ni// sgo yi ya thim dag la gdags// oṃ me da ra hūm̐ druṃ phraṃ phraṃ ki li bh+yo rbad/ rta phyugs god kha thams cad bsrung du gsol/ oṃ me ta ra hūm̐ druṃ/ oṃ ki la bh+yo phaṭa/ rta phyugs god kha thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes pa bris dang bzlas pa'o// ces pa'i man ngag gdams pa 'di// 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa'o// gsum pa shug phur dag la ni// sngags 'di bris la brgya rtsa bzlas// phur pa dag la gdab par bya// phur pa sri nang bcug gyur na// zas kyi bse rag kha chings 'gyur// oṃ ru lu mu lu tsit+ta swā hā/

oṃ ru lu mu lu tsan dhe swā hā/ mang du bzla/ bse rag kha chings mi shes par// dbul ser sgrub pa byas gyur kyang*// tshong pa dgra yis bcom pa 'dra// nor rnyed god khas mnan pa lags// de skad 'gro bzang snying pos gsungs// rnam thos sgrub pa'i gang zag kun// gdams pa 'di 'dra mi shes na// lag rdum gser gling phyin dang mtshungs// zhes pa'i gdams ngag dam pa 'di// 'gro bzang snying po'i dgongs don bzhin// ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen gyis// brjed thor bkod pas dge legs 'phel// ka l+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
